home.home_eyebrow: 2020 Forest River FR3 · Bunkhouse Floorplan · Sleeps 10
home.home_intro: A 2020 Forest River FR3 with THE smartest Floor Plan for Dinner, Games and Hangout — the Dining Table faces the Couch, which is rare. Sleeps 10, or 6 adults. Based in Redlands, California, with delivery available across Southern California.
home.own_para1: This is a single privately owned RV rather than one unit out of a rental fleet. It is inspected mechanically, deep-cleaned and restocked by the owner between every rental, and every renter receives the same vehicle in the same condition.
home.own_para2: The practical result is direct answers before you book, a 45-minute systems walkthrough before you depart, and a direct line to the owner for the duration of your rental.
home.own_point1: One owner, one RV — the one you see is the one you receive
home.own_point2: Mechanical inspection and deep clean between every rental
home.own_point3: Delivery, setup and collection available across Southern California
home.own_point4: Rates, fees and requirements published in full before you inquire
home.cards_intro: A king bed, a full bed over the cab, two pull-out couches, a dinette conversion and bunks. Ten berths in total, which works out to roughly six adults in comfort. Complete specifications are on the next page.
home.card1_text: The Dining Table faces the Couch rather than a wall — rare in a Class A, and the reason Dinner, Games and Hangout actually work in here. Swivel the cab seats around, add a few lawn chairs, and you can seat 12.
home.card2_text: A 12 cu ft 4-door RV refer with a real freezer, plus cooktop, oven, residential microwave and a complete set of cookware, dishware and utensils on board.
home.card3_text: A 72" x 80" king, a full bed over the cab, bunks, two pull-out couches and a dinette conversion bed. Ten berths suits kids in the mix; six adults is the comfortable number. Eight seatbelts for travel.
home.proc1_text: Call or text with your dates and party size.
home.proc2_text: Sign the rental agreement, send proof of insurance, pay the deposit.
home.proc3_text: A 45-minute walkthrough — no special license needed, it drives like a Dream. Or we deliver and set it up at your site.
home.proc4_text: The owner is reachable the whole time you're out.
home.proof_text: The RV has been rented and reviewed on Outdoorsy since 2020, where the listing currently sits in the top 5% of hosts in the United States.
home.proof_note: Booking directly avoids the platform's booking fee.

rv.rv_heading: Our Home away from Home, in detail.
rv.rv_intro: Fourteen photographs of the RV, the complete specification sheet, the Bunkhouse Floorplan, and a full list of what is on board.
rv.rv_spec_intro: A 34-foot Class A gas RV on an automatic transmission. No special license needed — it drives like a Dream. Any figure not listed here can be confirmed from the door sticker on request.
rv.rv_floorplan_text: Front king bedroom with wardrobes, kitchen and booth dinette mid-coach, couches on both sides, and a power fold-away bunk. The Dining Table faces the Couch rather than a wall.
rv.rv_equip_intro: All of the following is on board as standard. Renters typically need only food, clothing and bedding — and bedding is available as an add-on if you would rather not pack it.

rates.fee_deposit_text: Refundable, returned within 5 days of a clean return.
rates.fee_pet_text: Dogs welcome. No cats. No smoking.

book.book_intro: The calendar below reflects current availability. Dates are held only once a booking request has been confirmed in writing.
book.book_side_text: Every rental to date has begun with a call or a text. Inquiries reach the owner directly and are answered in person rather than routed through a form.
book.rule_driver: A valid standard driver's license is sufficient; no CDL is required. Additional drivers must be named on the rental agreement.
book.rule_insurance: Proof of insurance required before pickup.
book.rule_smoking: Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside the vehicle at all times. A violation forfeits the security deposit.
book.rule_pets: Pet friendly — dogs welcome with a $125 fee. No cats.
book.rule_generator: 6 generator hours / day included. Campground quiet hours, typically 10pm–7am, must be observed.
book.rule_return: 6 PM end time. A 90-minute grace period applies, after which $50 per hour or part hour is charged.

contactpage.contact_intro: Inquiries are handled by the owner. There is no call center and no booking agent.
contactpage.contact_side_text: Text and telephone both reach the owner directly. If a call goes unanswered, please leave a message and it will be returned.

legal.legal_terms:
The renter must hold a valid standard driver's license, and be listed on the signed rental agreement. Additional drivers must also be listed. The renter is responsible for the motorhome from pickup until return, including fines, tolls, and damage not covered by insurance.

Proof of insurance is required before keys are handed over. A $500 refundable security deposit is collected before pickup and returned within five business days of a clean return.

No smoking or vaping inside the vehicle at any time. Pets are permitted only when agreed in writing in advance. The motorhome may not be taken off paved or established campground roads, used for commercial purposes, or driven outside the continental United States without written permission.

Included mileage is 100 miles per day; additional miles are quoted before the trip. Six generator hours per day are included. The vehicle must be returned with fuel and propane at pickup levels and with holding tanks emptied, or applicable service fees apply.
legal.legal_cancellation:
Cancellations 30 or more days before the pickup date receive a full refund of all payments including the deposit. Cancellations 14 to 29 days out receive a 50% refund of rental charges plus the full deposit. Cancellations inside 14 days are non-refundable, though the deposit is always returned.

If a mechanical problem on our end makes the motorhome unavailable, you receive a full refund without exception, and we will help find an alternative where we can. Cancellations for documented severe weather, road closures, or wildfire evacuation orders affecting your destination are handled case-by-case and have always been resolved in the renter's favor.
legal.legal_privacy:
This website carries no analytics or advertising trackers. The two forms on this site submit through our hosting provider, Netlify, which stores the submission so we can read and reply to it. Nothing else about your visit is recorded.

Information you do send us — name, phone, email, dates, driver's license and insurance details required for the rental agreement — is used only to arrange and service your rental. It is never sold or shared with third parties beyond what is required to complete the booking, such as an insurance provider you have asked us to contact. Records tied to a completed rental are retained as long as needed for tax and liability purposes and then destroyed.
